env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.reason: Required when using the native OpenAI provider.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.reason: Required when using the Anthropic provider without OpenAI.

env.name: AIRLINE_MODEL_PROVIDER
env.reason: Existing provider selector; relai selects the repository scoped model transport.

env.name: RELAI_API_BASE
env.reason: Gateway URL required when AIRLINE_MODEL_PROVIDER is relai; model transport only, not an application backend.

env.name: RELAI_SESSION_MODEL
env.reason: Server-pinned model name required by the existing relai provider.

env.name: RELAI_TEAM_API_KEY
env.reason: Scoped gateway credential required by the existing relai provider.

env.name: ATIF_REDACT_ENV_VARS
env.reason: Optional comma-separated variable names for the repository recorder's additional redaction sources; contains names only.
